artifacts.summary: Diagnoses the finding-level granularity gap in verify-deploy.sh gates 3-4 and designs an additive --findings mode plus pre/post baseline diff for the inter-cycle redeploy checkpoint, including the exit-2 resolution and the skill-orchestrate-hard CO-MAINTENANCE file_scope gap.

memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh's gates 1-2 already itemize every failure unconditionally (their fail() ignores --quiet), but gates 3-4 (doc-lint, task-reference lint) discard the wrapped sub-script's output via '--quiet >/dev/null 2>&1', collapsing arbitrary findings into one aggregate line. check-extension-docs.sh's own fail()/advisory() already survive --quiet (only its info() is quiet-gated), so capturing its output with --quiet still passed already gives full per-extension detail. check-task-references.sh is the opposite: its per-finding lines ARE quiet-gated, so it must be invoked WITHOUT --quiet to get line-level detail. Any future finding-level machine-output mode on verify-deploy.sh should reuse this asymmetry rather than rediscovering it.

skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md and skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md carry explicit CO-MAINTENANCE-annotated duplicated logic blocks (e.g. the inter-cycle redeploy checkpoint, Stage MT-3 step 7) that must be edited in lockstep. A task's file_scope in specs/state.json can name only one of the pair, creating a real risk that an implementer updates the base engine and silently skips the hard-mode mirror. When planning any change to a Stage MT-3/MT-4 mechanism, check both SKILL.md files for a 'Transcribed:' / 'CO-MAINTENANCE' marker before assuming file_scope is complete.
